generation_revision_notes: Second batch isolates Boss and VFX concepts into transparent RGBA PNG candidates on 512x512 canvases.

Boss charge_attack was regenerated as a grounded forward-driving pose after the first candidate read as a leap; the leap variant is archived under RuntimeWIP/Variants and is excluded from the delivery list.
The source PNGs are flattened image outputs. Layered PSD, Aseprite or other editable authoring projects are not included.

required_before_runtime: Complete animation/VFX sequences and frame timing
Freeze source format, anchors and contact/emission points
Confirm Presenter hooks for player action start/hold states
Engineer-led UE import and P4 viewport/PIE review

engineering_event_contract.rule: Art timing only follows the existing simulation contract and never changes hitboxes, damage or event IDs.
event_mapping_notes: player_melee_miss must not show a confirmed contact impact.
fx_boss_lid_slam may play for hit or missed results because the slam occurred, but it is not a player damage signal.
fx_boss_charge_trail starts only during the actual charge presentation, not in its telegraph.

vfx_sequence_batch.nominal_frame_rate: per-frame durations are authoritative; sequences use variable display rates
vfx_sequence_batch.motion_source: source stills transformed by scale, opacity and small pivot offsets only; rotation was removed after alpha-edge QA detected clipping
vfx_sequence_batch.low_intensity_fallback: Fade/opacity frames are provided in each sequence; dedicated hand-redrawn accessibility variants remain pending.
